chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
If you fasted the Month of Ramadan in the previous year on a known day, then in the coming year count five days from that day and fast on the fifth day.

key_terms.شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ: the Month of Ramadan, the month of obligatory fasting
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْخَامِسِ: the fifth day, on which fasting is to be done

ai.seo_question: How should one estimate the start of Ramadan based on the previous year's fasting date?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction related to determining the beginning of Ramadan by using the previous year's observed date as a reference point. It reflects a practical method for fasting observance within the broader jurisprudence of moon-sighting and the start of the lunar month.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If you fasted the Month of Ramadan on a specific day in the previous year, then in the following year count five days from that day and fast on the fifth day."
